_source: Common tutorial / blog-post pattern (broadly across AWS Lambda walkthroughs)
_source_url: https://github.com/aws-samples (anti-pattern — frequently appears in tutorials before scope-down step)
_pattern_description: Lambda execution role with broad service wildcards (s3:*, dynamodb:*, sns:*) and no Conditions. Common 'make it work first' pattern that often ships to production unchanged. No full admin (Action: *), but service wildcards on Resource: * enable significant blast radius.
